ranked.headline: Computational inference of gene regulation and genome architecture from single-cell data
ranked.summary: New models pair lineage barcodes, recombination barcodes, and contact maps with single-cell data to resolve regulatory and genome-structure states.

ranked.headline: Omics models increasingly tested against specific failure modes, not aggregate scores
ranked.summary: Background confounding, outlier sensitivity and batch effects now motivate evaluation beyond single aggregate metrics in omics modeling.

ranked.headline: Supervised models decode clinical and molecular labels from omics and biomedical graphs
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks foundation-model embeddings, feature screening and Bayesian selection for molecular prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Reduced and agent-based models capture cell-population dynamics across tumors, lesions…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply reduced, agent-based and reaction-diffusion models to tumor, tuberculosis, multiple sclerosis and bacterial community dynamics.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and spatial mapping predict tissue mechanical behavior across scales
ranked.summary: Image-based and AFM-derived mechanical measurements now enable learned surrogates for stress and viscoelastic maps in biological tissues.

ranked.headline: Pretrained RNA language model embeddings paired with graph and state-space architectures
ranked.summary: Preprints and publications now pair pretrained biological language model embeddings with explicit architectures for RNA prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational reconstruction of tissue architecture from imaging and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent work couples histology, cell painting, and spatial omics with deep learning and topological descriptors to quantify tissue structure.

ranked.headline: Synaptic structure sets limits on population decoding and network coding efficiency
ranked.summary: Preprints now couple synaptic tuning, sign constraints, and conductance directly to decoding limits and efficiency predictions in formal neural models.

ranked.headline: Representing spatial and genetic dependence in pathogen transmission inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed mobility graphs, spatio-temporal priors, and viral haplotype similarity directly into transmission and outbreak inference models.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize ligands and binding partners for protein targets
ranked.summary: New preprints and papers extend GPCR de-orphanization, sequence-based affinity prediction, and GPU virtual screening across large interaction spaces.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models tested on unseen enzyme labels and variant pathogenicity
ranked.summary: Label-scarce and unseen-label regimes now test whether learned sequence representations generalize beyond their training annotations.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose failure modes of AI structure and binding predictors
ranked.summary: Preprints now test learned protein and ligand predictors against experimental data, energy landscapes, and adversarial inputs, exposing reliability limits.

ranked.headline: Genomic analyses increasingly move beyond a single fixed reference coordinate system
ranked.summary: Recent methods tailor genotype representations to each inference task, from GxE testing and ancestry estimation to neural-network association and low-coverage…

ranked.headline: Experimental and computational constraints refine RNA structure and dynamics models
ranked.summary: Structure-seq, FRET-guided selection and ML-potential benchmarks now offer explicit checks on predicted RNA structures and conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Graph and foundation models integrate multi-omics and knowledge graphs for prediction
ranked.summary: Knowledge graphs, single-cell foundation models and multi-omics learners now predict drug indications, perturbations and microbiome states.

ranked.headline: Computational models link chromatin architecture, nucleosome dynamics and cancer eccDNAs
ranked.summary: Deep learning and MD-based methods now predict chromatin contacts, nucleosome allostery, and cancer eccDNAs from binding, dynamics, and sequence data.

ranked.headline: Scoring frameworks integrate orthology, domain, and structure to annotate proteomes
ranked.summary: Multi-evidence scoring of eukaryotic proteomes, spanning mitochondrial targeting, complex orthogroups, and secretome folds, appears in February 2026 preprints.

ranked.headline: Reaction networks predict cell-free expression and CRISPRa gRNA competition
ranked.summary: Reaction-network models of cell-free and CRISPRa systems are now validated against data and used to guide genetic design.

ranked.headline: Network models link microbial interaction balance and drug combination prediction
ranked.summary: Microbiome-aware network models are now predicting therapy response and gut health markers from interaction structure.

ranked.headline: Computational models for protein sequence design and structural trajectory mapping
ranked.summary: Protein language model trajectories and rule-based sequence generation are now paired with experimental import testing in yeast and multi-scale inhibitor…

ranked.headline: Software pipelines for single-molecule localisation, receptor FRET, and cryo-EM maps
ranked.summary: Reference-free statistics and accessible tools now bundle acquisition, fitting, and interpretation for MINFLUX, FRET, and cryo-EM data.

ranked.headline: Continuous and hierarchical models resolve transcriptomic state beyond discrete types
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tumor study model cell state at patient, regulatory-network, or geometric levels rather than cell type alone.

ranked.headline: Protein language models diverge from natural language in layerwise information use
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and architectural analyses now probe how protein language models process repeats and layers, moving beyond sequence scoring.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for small-molecule identification and property prediction
ranked.summary: Open benchmarks, curation pipelines, and closed-loop frameworks are standardizing evaluation of computational methods for molecular prediction.

ranked.headline: New chromosome-scale assemblies for kelp, a coral, and a microsporidian symbiont
ranked.summary: Long-read and telomere-to-telomere assemblies now resolve chromosome-scale genomes across brown alga, reef coral, and microsporidian symbiont lineages.

ranked.headline: New frameworks encode technical and biological structure into omics inference models
ranked.summary: Recent open-source tools embed batch effects, phylogeny and missing data within inference rather than treating them as preprocessing.

ranked.headline: Statistical and simulation tools map genetic regulation in transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Population-scale RNA phenotyping and simulation frameworks now allow regulatory inference to be benchmarked and power-corrected across samples and ancestries.

ranked.headline: Web tools couple cross-platform data harmonisation with interactive feature exploration
ranked.summary: Recent tools package omics data transformation, meta-analysis and biomarker visualisation in interactive, web-accessible formats.

ranked.headline: Computational resources span top-down MS, DIA workflows, nanopore sensing, neoantigens
ranked.summary: Large public top-down spectral repositories and systematic DIA benchmarks on Astral MS now sit alongside nanopore and immunopeptidogenomic pipelines.

ranked.headline: Constraints from density, energy and ensembles enter structural modeling workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple cryo-EM density, conformational ensemble benchmarks, and pocket-level analysis to model refinement and validation.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free k-mers separate viral sequence classes; pangenome graphs benchmarked
ranked.summary: Alignment-free k-mer features now distinguish closely related pathogen sequences and expose representation effects in pangenome graph construction.

ranked.headline: Sequencing pipelines validated against defined references or simulated datasets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published method report accuracy-checked pipelines for long-read, metatranscriptomic, rDNA, and plant-DNA sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Long-read and large-scale methods resolve post-transcriptional RNA regulation
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and large-scale maps now quantify RNA-binding, transcript isoforms, and translational buffering across platforms and species.

ranked.headline: Graph pangenomes resolve structural variants linked to traits and climate adaptation
ranked.summary: Long-read pangenome graphs now resolve structural and transposable element variants tied to crop traits, climate adaptation, and organellar insertions.

ranked.headline: Network inference exposes signaling rewiring in drug resistance and EGF pathways
ranked.summary: New benchmarks and dynamic network models are being applied to phosphoproteomics, transcriptomics and proteomics in cancer and EGF signaling.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained models tested for ligand and DNA binding and folding free energies
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained force fields and geometric formalisms are being checked against free energy references for ligands, hairpins, and protein-DNA complexes.

ranked.headline: DNA methylation profiling and sequence-level frameworks for epigenomic annotation
ranked.summary: Long-read methylation profiling and sequence-aware frameworks now link epigenetic state to biomarkers, editing dynamics and genomic instability.

ranked.headline: Re-engineering established sequence analysis tools for speed, portability and scale
ranked.summary: Simulators and selection-scan methods are being rebuilt for multithreaded throughput and automated, portable use on large sequence datasets.

ranked.headline: Closed-loop and flow-inertia models yield tractable timescales for biological dynamics
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair minimal closed-loop and flow-inertia formulations with analytical timescales and loop diagnostics for multi-level biological dynamics.
